name: 48108 · Ann Arbor, MI
findings: ZIP 48108 (Ann Arbor) has 202 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48108 (Ann Arbor) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48108 (Ann Arbor) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 91 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
